Two tests give at most 4 outcomes, so the best I can do is narrow it to 2 cases per outcome. That means I'll still have to guess at the end.

- **Lights up (4 cases):** all 3 "needs one" cases, since every pair includes ruvidi or vabunan. Also "needs two" with nukape–ruvidi.
- **Stays dark (4 cases):** "needs two" with nukape–funozes, bokiril–ruvidi, bokiril–funozes or ruvidi–funozes.

TEST: nukape, ruvidi, vabunan
Result: the machine did NOT light up. You have 1 test left. Make your next move.

The dark result rules out every "needs one" case, along with nukape–ruvidi. So the machine **needs two**, and 4 pairs remain:
- nukape–funozes
- bokiril–ruvidi
- bokiril–funozes
- ruvidi–funozes

One test gives 2 outcomes, so the best I can do is narrow it to 2 pairs and then guess between them.

Next I'll test nukape, bokiril and funozes:
- **Lights up:** the pair is nukape–funozes or bokiril–funozes.
- **Stays dark:** the pair is bokiril–ruvidi or ruvidi–funozes.

TEST: nukape, bokiril, funozes
Result: the machine did NOT light up. You have used all your tests. Give your ANSWER now.

The dark result leaves two possible pairs, bokiril–ruvidi or ruvidi–funozes, and the machine needs two. No test left can tell these apart, so this is a 50/50 guess. I'll go with ruvidi–funozes.
